E2-2021-T1-P1-S1.trunk: S+系动词+表语：Reskilling is something but is actually a requirement（技能再培训看似某物，实则是一项必要举措）
structure: │   └ 定语从句(that)：that sounds like a buzzword
└ 转折并列系表结构②：but is actually a requirement
└ 条件状语从句(if)：if we plan to have a future
└ 定语从句(where)：where a lot of would-be workers do not get left behind
E2-2021-T1-P1-S1.logic: but 把表面印象和实际必要性对照；if 给出必要性的前提，where 从句具体描述所期望的未来。
notes: get left behind：被落下、无法跟上变化。

E2-2021-T1-P1-S11.trunk: 并列谓语：Efforts have been languid and have given us a situation（相关努力迟缓，并造成一种局面）
structure: 主语：Efforts in Canada and elsewhere
├ 谓语①：have been arguably languid at best
└ 并列谓语②：have given us a situation
└ 定语从句(where)：where we frequently hear of employers begging for workers
└ 让步状语：even at times and in regions where unemployment is high
E2-2021-T1-P1-S11.logic: 两个并列谓语先评价政策努力，再说明其后果；两个 where 分别限定“局面”和“地区”，构成高失业与缺工并存的反差。
notes: languid at best：充其量只能说进展迟缓。
hear of somebody doing：听说某人正在做某事。
beg for workers：迫切寻找工人。

E2-2021-T1-P1-S18.trunk: That seems to be the case: Scandinavian Airlines decided to start a program（情况似乎正是如此：航空公司决定启动计划）
structure: 引导句：That seems to be the case in Sweden
├ 时间/条件省略结构：When forced to furlough 90 per cent of their cabin staff
└ 宾语不定式：to start up a short retraining program
└ 定语从句(that)：that reskilled the laid-off workers to support hospital staff
E2-2021-T1-P1-S18.logic: 冒号后的瑞典案例解释 that 指代的可弥合技能缺口情形；when 说明触发背景，that 从句说明培训计划的作用。
notes: laid-off workers：被裁撤或停职的员工。
reskill somebody to do：为某人再培训，使其能够做某事。
